name: mymind
summary: Private visual memory that organizes what you save on its own.
description: mymind keeps articles, images, notes and products with no folders or tags to manage: AI sorts them and finds them from a simple description. The app has no ads and no social sharing.
summary_fr: Mémoire visuelle privée qui organise tout seul ce que tu enregistres.
description_fr: mymind conserve articles, images, notes et produits sans dossiers ni étiquettes à gérer : l'IA les classe et les retrouve par simple description. L'application ne contient ni publicité ni partage social.
